regime_context: The detector shows a one-narrative market with Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO) as the clear leader — rank 1, eligible under the absolute-trend gate, highest durability (0.71), and very high breadth (0.929) — but it is crowded (z=1.19) and the rotation view is 'narrowing' with only 38% of themes eligible. Gold Miners (XGD.TO) is the challenger on raw score but is NOT eligible (durability 0.16, breadth 0.067), so the leadership is concentrated but the rotation handoff is not confirmed. The one validated edge here is the trend gate for drawdown control (gate_helps=true); momentum rank itself is not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (XGD.TO) crosses into trend-gate eligibility with durability_bar rising above ~0.5 and breadth above ~0.3 for a sustained stretch — the condition that would retire this watch is a confirmed handoff where Gold Miners' score closes the 0.895 margin to Oil & Gas and Gold Miners' eligibility flips to true.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: This is the only theme combining trend-gate eligibility with dominant leadership, high durability (0.71) and near-maximum breadth (0.929). Per guardrails this is a trend-following, vol-aware lean expressed as a conditional — not a return forecast. Crowding (z=1.19, crowded=true) and one-narrative concentration are reasons to keep conviction low and treat any allocation as capped, never chased on the flag itself.
evidence: gate_helps=true and absolute_trend_gate validated for drawdown control
theses.dissent: A crowded one-narrative energy trade can reverse hard on a single macro headline (unscheduled_share is 0.75 in the macro flow, meaning surprise-driven tape); with momentum rank-IC ~0 there is no evidence the leadership itself adds forward return, and a crowding unwind in one narrow theme can be sudden for a concentrated TSX.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 50-day moving average while remaining under the trend gate for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Trend-gate eligible (eligible=true, durability 0.71, hurst_tag 'trend') with 50% breadth and no crowding flag. It is the lower-beta, income-oriented expression of the same dominant energy narrative as the leader, so a modest lean aligns with the trend discipline without directly chasing the crowded leader. Unscorable (no proxy), so confidence is capped and this is a directional lean only.
evidence: same Energy category as leader but less extended
theses.dissent: It is unscorable (no ETF proxy) so the lean cannot be cleanly graded, and it is part of the same one-narrative energy umbrella — if that narrative rolls over, midstream rolls with it rather than diversifying.

falsifier.text: If a scorable broad-energy benchmark (XEG.TO) falls 8% from the note date while long Canada crude names lag the TSX, the midstream lean is not working before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners shows a strong raw score (rank 2, 1.015) but fails the absolute trend gate (eligible=false) with weak durability (0.16) and extremely narrow breadth (0.067). Per the validated edge, this is exactly the kind of theme the gate screens out for shake-out risk, and the rotation to gold is NOT confirmed. This is an avoid, not a short or fade.
evidence: rotation.challenger but margin 0.895 and handoff unconfirmed
theses.dissent: Precious metals can catch a geopolitical bid (macro_narrative shows geopolitics headline flow) and the raw momentum score is second only to the leader, so an unconfirmed but quick rotation into gold is possible — avoid is a risk-control call, not an alpha call.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO becomes trend-gate eligible with durability above 0.5 and breadth above 0.5 for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
